name: Proxy
author: alexwoo79
description: System proxy state in the bar, driven by proxyctl: on/off, the endpoint in use, a live health probe through the proxy, and click to toggle.

barWidget.description: Click opens a panel: endpoint input, system proxy and TUN switches, live health and exit IP, and the state of every layer proxyctl writes

schema.label: Proxy address
schema.description: host:port enabled when the proxy is off. Use an endpoint that is actually serving a proxy — the address drifts when DHCP moves it.

schema.label: Health check interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget probes the proxy with curl. The probe only runs while the proxy is on.

schema.label: Health check
schema.description: Probe through the proxy so the bar can tell 'on' from 'working'. Turn off to keep the widget display-only.
